rationale: 50 goals is the whole of D_test, the largest held-out block the 100-goal JBB pool allows after reserving direction/calibration/budget/dev. It puts the matched-control half-width at 0.0055, i.e. 5.4x inside the SESOI, so the DECISIVE equivalence comparisons are comfortably powered.
stated_limitation: The design is NOT fully powered for the weak-baseline stratum. Detecting the +0.018 cantor-vs-true-constant effect at 80% power needs 61 goals; at 50 the power is 72%. This is registered in advance: a null result on that secondary comparison will be reported as INCONCLUSIVE (underpowered), never as evidence of equivalence.
